import { Controller, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { InjectRepository, TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import {
  MessagePattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Payload,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';
import { Entity, PrimaryColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import Redlock from 'redlock';

@Entity('report_job')
export class ReportJob {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare status: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class ReportLockService {
  constructor(private readonly redlock: Redlock) {}

  execute<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.redlock.using(['locks:reports'], 5_000, async () => task());
  }
}

@Controller()
export class ReportWorkerController {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(ReportJob) private readonly jobs: Repository<ReportJob>,
    private readonly locks: ReportLockService,
  ) {}

  @MessagePattern('report.generate')
  handle(@Payload() payload: unknown): Promise<void> {
    return this.locks.execute(async () => {
      await this.jobs.save({ status: payload === undefined ? 'empty' : 'queued' });
    });
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([ReportJob])],
  controllers: [ReportWorkerController],
  providers: [ReportLockService],
})
export class ReportWorkerModule {}

async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  await NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(ReportWorkerModule, {
    transport: Transport.RMQ,
    options: { queue: 'reports_queue' },
  });
}

void bootstrap;
